title: `requestDevice()` step 7.6 sets an already-open device's state to "closed"
body:
### What is the issue with the WebHID Standard?

In the [`requestDevice()` method steps](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#requestdevice-method), step 7.6 says:

> [For each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) device of [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this).[[[devices]]](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hid-devices-slot):
>    1. If device represents a [HID interface](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-hid-interface) exposed by the chosen device, then set device.[[[state]]](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hiddevice-state-slot) to "closed" and [append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) device to devices.

However, if the user chooses a device in `[[devices]]` that was already open, this would mark it as closed.

Suggested fix:
> [For each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) device of [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this).[[[devices]]](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hid-devices-slot):
>    1. If device represents a [HID interface](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-hid-interface) exposed by the chosen device, then:
>        1.  If device.[[state]] is "forgotten", set device.[[state]] to "closed".
>        2.  [Append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) device to devices.
